item.title: Apache Airflow FAB Auth Manager Azure AD JWT Signature Bypass — Pre-Auth Admin Takeover (CVE-2026-59243)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2026-59243 (Apache advisory, 2026-07-29; CWE-347). Status: PoC — working end-to-end against the bundled simulation of the vulnerable decode path; not run against a live Airflow deployment by the archivist. Affects: Apache Airflow — FAB auth manager (apache-airflow-providers-fab), Azure AD OAuth login path. Tags: Apache Airflow, FAB auth manager, OAuth, Azure AD, JWT, alg:none, signature verification bypass, CWE-347, authentication bypass, admin takeover, pre-auth.
